findings.detail: testnet-build.yml release job publishes a GitHub release with `gh release create` from generated notes (testnet-build.yml:44-71). The job contains no signing step, no attestation step, and no checksum step. Grep of all ten workflow files for cosign|sigstore|attest|gpg|sha256sum|checksum|slsa returned no release-signing step (the only gpg hits are the Caddy apt key in deploy.yml and the Ripple package-repo key in docs).

build.yml builds and pushes Docker images agtipft/postfiatd to a registry with mutable -latest tags (build.yml:71-90). No image-signing step (Cosign) exists anywhere in the workflows. An in-tree review document explicitly defers image signing (Cosign) to Phase 2 or mainnet (docs/dynamic-unl/reviews/FeedbackAnalysis_Codex54.md:335,341).

docs/build/install.md:33-41 tells installers to trust Ripple's GPG package-signing key for the rippled deb/rpm package repositories. This signs Ripple's package repository, not postfiatd releases, and does not cover the GitHub releases or Docker images this pack assesses.

src/libxrpl/protocol/SecretKey.cpp sign() (lines 256-290): Ed25519 signs a 64-byte signature via ed25519_sign; secp256k1 ECDSA signs the sha512Half digest with RFC6979 deterministic nonce and DER serialization. signDigest() (lines 230-253) is secp256k1-only. verify() in PublicKey.cpp (lines 289-316) dispatches by key type: secp256k1 verifies the sha512Half digest with canonicality checks and low-S normalization (verifyDigest, lines 240-283); Ed25519 strips the 0xED key prefix, checks signature canonicality, and calls ed25519_sign_open. This is protocol signing (validations, manifests), NOT release signing.

ManifestCache::applyManifest() rejects a manifest whose sequence number is not strictly greater than the stored one (Manifest.cpp:411-413, logged Invalid). Manifest::revoked() treats sequence == UINT32_MAX as a master-key revocation (Manifest.cpp:236-240). Manifest::verify() checks both the ephemeral signing-key signature and the master-key signature over HashPrefix::manifest (Manifest.cpp:196-216). ValidatorList v2 messages only include VLs with sequence larger than the peer's (ValidatorList.cpp:623-648). These mechanisms protect signed validator data against replay/rollback; no equivalent mechanism exists for postfiatd releases.

Grep of the pinned tree for release signing returned nothing: no file implements, calls, or documents signing of postfiatd releases (no 'release sign', no cosign/sigstore/gpg usage in any workflow, no checksum manifest for releases). The migration target is therefore the release PROCESS (GitHub releases + Docker images), not an in-tree signing implementation.
findings.evidence: grep -rln -i 'release.*sign|sign.*release|cosign|sigstore' over src/, .github/, docs/ (pinned tree); see docs/SOURCES.md

negative_searches.verdict: no release-signing step; only unrelated hits (Caddy apt key in deploy.yml)
no matches except docs/build/install.md (Ripple package-repo GPG key, not postfiatd releases)
no matches; the only Cosign mention in the tree is the deferral note in docs/dynamic-unl/reviews/FeedbackAnalysis_Codex54.md:335,341

note: 'measured-absence' means the absence was established by enumerating the complete set of places where the mechanism would have to live (all ten workflow files; the whole tree for release-signing references) and finding nothing. It is a verified absence from the pinned tree, not an inference. The current release-signing mechanism of postfiatd, if any exists outside the pinned tree (for example a manual step by a maintainer), is [UNSUPPORTED]: it is not observable from the pinned tree, and this pack does not claim to know it.
